You are working on POLUS, a Godot 4.7 first-person survival sandbox (low-poly, flat-shaded; browser build = Compatibility renderer / WebGL2, single-threaded; server-authoritative, deterministic — this wave is visual only and must not change any simulation number). Project root: polus. Godot: .hub-tools/godot/godot (headless only; screenshots only in the browser).

THIS TASK = wave 67: Maxim approved every material concept («давай выкатывать все текстуры крутые апрув мне нравится надо в игру»). Bring the HD look into the game per .orchestra/tasks/63/looks/spec.md, steps 1-5 and 7 of §7 (the ground step 6 waits for the layered-ground wave; do NOT touch the ground / dig look). READ FIRST: .orchestra/tasks/67/README.md, .orchestra/tasks/63/looks/spec.md (all of it: pipeline, formats in the Compatibility renderer §2.3, biplanar + UDN normals §2.4, the anchor §2.5, per-kind parameters §2.6, skin vs fresh §3, crystals §5 incl. honest F0: glass 4 %, ice 1.8 %, diamond 17 %, red absorption in thick ice, the two tiers and costs, shader sketches §8), .orchestra/tasks/63/looks/out/stage.md (the processed textures: 24 albedo + height / normal / roughness, 5 redone, RG-packed crystal masks mask-glass / mask-ice / mask-quartz _packed.png, normal-hackle; the shader must normalise the albedo to mean 1 because the game multiplies by the kind tint), .orchestra/tasks/62/feel2/look/stage.md (item 5: stone texture in object space now — keep it; pieces carry the parent anchor), docs/GAMEDESIGN-LESSONS-YAMA.md. LOOK at the concept balls .orchestra/tasks/63/concepts/concept-granite.png, concept-ice.png, concept-glass.png, concept-quartz.png, concept-diamond-v2.png, concept-gravel.png and at the processed textures' contact sheet .orchestra/tasks/63/looks/out/preview/_sheet.jpg with Read.
RULE of Maxim: the concept is not a blueprint — the low-poly faceted look stays; the textures add surface, not photorealism; the stone must still read flat-shaded at 3 m. Beauty without lag.

FENCE: a parallel wave 66 (craft + ledger) runs in the same checkout and owns systems/*, world/tools/*, world/items/*, world/hud/*, world/craft/*, world/matter/*, world/dig/*, world/fx/chips.gd, world/chop/branches.gd, world/build/*, world/range/*, world/glade/glade.gd, world/map/valley_map.gd, world/map/valley_tour.gd, entities/hands/head_models.gd. NEVER edit those. This wave may own: world/rocks/rock.gdshader, world/rocks/rock_mesh.gd, world/stone/stone_batch.gd, world/rocks/brittle.gd (only its look constants, if any), export_presets.cfg (texture formats S3TC + ETC2), new files under world/looks/ (textures imported there — assets/* is excluded from the export), new shader files, and the look tests. Anything else: a named one-line hook, said in notes.

TESTS: every behaviour gets a check that FAILS before (red log) and passes after (green log) where a number exists: the texture arrays load in the web build in both formats (log line), albedo mean ~1 after normalisation per layer, object-space anchor (the texture coordinate at a fixed local vertex is the same before / after moving and rotating; a break keeps the parent's anchor in the pieces: seam continuity number), F0 per crystal, no simulation number changes (det vs .orchestra/tasks/62/feel2/main/det_ref_f3 must be identical; .orchestra/tasks/62/w1/compare.sh, det via .orchestra/tasks/62/w1/law/det.sh), perf: the valley tour polygon stop <= 300 draws (240 now) and the frame cost of a stone-heavy view (the material range) measured in the browser before / after, web build size < 95 MB (it is ~50 MB). Browser shots side by side with the concept balls, at 0.5 m and 3 m, with a written list of differences.

Task folder: .orchestra/tasks/67/<your part>/ — notes, scripts, logs, shots there. RESTART SAFETY: the T3 server restarts every few hours; you may be a re-run: FIRST read your notes.md and continue (edits are on disk; 'git diff 4326e21 -- <file>'). Append to notes.md after each step; API others need at the TOP.
HUB LIMITS (Maxim «как мыши», 05.11): one godot of yours at a time, after 'python3 export/hub_guard.py --need-gb 3 --wait 1800 --quiet', with nice -n 10 and 'echo 1000 > /proc/self/oom_score_adj'; long runs via Bash run_in_background with an explicit timeout; never nohup or detached chains. The browser ONLY via export/cdp.py (project-wide lock, one Chrome — wave 66 shares it; if google-chrome hangs on CDP use CDP_CHROME=chrome-headless-shell). Kill your servers / Chromes by PID. Never write outside the project. Do not commit, do not publish. Refresh imports under the lock: flock build/.build.lock .hub-tools/godot/godot --headless --path . --import. Web build: OUT=build/web-<name> bash export/build_web.sh (serialises itself); serve: python3 export/serve.py <PORT> nocoi polus/build/web-<name>; browser: python3 export/cdp.py "http://127.0.0.1:<PORT>/index.html?<query>" <outdir> --port <CDP_PORT> --size 960x540 --timeout <s> --shot MARKER=name.png (the materials bot has shots modes). Your final answer is data for the orchestrator: what you did, files, checks with numbers (red / green), shots, open issues; be honest.

YOUR PART: map (folder .orchestra/tasks/67/map/). READ-ONLY on game code; write .orchestra/tasks/67/map/plan.md. Split spec steps 1-5 + 7 into 2 to 4 PARTS that run IN PARALLEL in one checkout inside the fence, with disjoint owned files (a file several parts need gets ONE owner; others get a named one-line hook). Likely: (a) pipeline + stone array textures + biplanar / UDN shader + skin vs fresh + anchor + formats; (b) crystals glass / ice / quartz / diamond / obsidian Tier 0 (+ Tier 1 refraction in the hand / inspect panel with an off switch), as new shader files hooked by one line; decide by the code. For each part: owns, hooks, browser yes / no, a plan of a few sentences (cause, change, test). Contracts between parts. Risks (web formats, cost on the range, the swim fix).
